title: Principal Network Security Engineer
description_html: Job Requisition ID #                      26WD100041       Position Overview   Autodesk is seeking an experienced  Principal Network Security Engineer  to lead the design, architecture, and maturity of our global network security infrastructure and its security posture. In this role, you'll set the strategic direction for network security, drive improvements across our cloud and hybrid networks, implement foundation controls and partner with key stakeholders in our Enterprise IT organization to deliver Trust outcomes.      Responsibilities       Design, architect, and plan strategy for deployment of Security technologies in a complex and distributed network infrastructure to mitigate risks    Design, implement and manage scalable security controls on network security for Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), SASE, Intrusion Detection Systems, and auditing tools in both public and private cloud infrastructures    Design, implement and manage scalable security controls for web application firewalling, bot protection, content redirection and manipulation in a hybrid public/private cloud    Manage Security policies, standards and reviews of network segmentation and other cloud-based network services    Develop and implement security protocols and procedures to prevent and mitigate potential threats in a cloud environment    Support with responding to security breaches promptly, conduct thorough investigations, and propose long-term solutions at a network level    Provide technical leadership and guidance in cloud network security matters    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure network security aligns with business objectives    Work closely with all Trust stakeholders for alignment on design and strategy    Develop automations to improve operational efficiency    Support compliance and regular security audits, generate reports for evidence, and provide recommendations for improvements    Stay abreast of the latest security trends, threats, and mitigation techniques       Minimum Qualifications       At least 8 years of network security experience, with a strong emphasis on cloud environments    Expertise in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and Security capabilities offered by these platforms    Knowledge of routing, load balancing and edge or perimeter network capabilities in cloud environments    Proven experience with security technologies (firewalls, intrusion detection systems, SASE, NAC, WAF, DDoS protection etc.)    Deep understanding and experience with DNS, NTP,  BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VPN, SD-WAN , and other critical protocols     Network monitoring and analytics tools (NetFlow, sFlow, packet analysis)     AI/ML-powered network security — covering anomaly detection, threat prediction, automated remediation, and intelligent analytics    Network configuration management and automation — covering IaC, Ansible, Terraform, GitOps, and NetOps/AIOps platforms    Strong knowledge of cybersecurity principles and best practices    Familiarity with Security and Privacy compliance standards (SOC2, ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, FedRamp etc.)    Bachelor's degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (CISSP, CISM, etc.) are a plus       Preferred Qualifications       Ability to influence stakeholders internal and external to Trust with design proposals and strategic recommendations    Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills    Strong communication and interpersonal skills    Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously      #LI-PJ1       Learn More         About Autodesk     Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.      We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.      When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!       Salary transparency   Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.   Belonging  We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here:    https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging       In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification   This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.
